title: Test a prespecified FOSB direction in GSE25628 surgical samples
question: Is the prespecified FOSB mean contrast positive in proliferative eutopic case versus surgical control endometrium?
scope: A separate single-probe comparison in a small surgical cohort with unknown individual hormone history.
steps: Freeze the endpoint and cohort before expression inspection.
Verify source groups, published sampling design, annotation and processing.
Compute the planned single-probe difference and uncertainty.
deliverables: Reproducible analysis, code, tests and aggregate-only outcome.
acceptance: Exactly eight eutopic case and six surgical control observations enter the single-probe test.
Where source requirements fail, record a blocker without switching endpoints.
Report uncertainty, exclusions, data versions, recruitment and unresolved treatment and control differences.
